context: In the lint pass, resolve each only_modify/do_not_modify glob and each verification command's file-path arguments against the repo working tree; report any that match nothing. Globs legitimately match nothing when a file is still to be created, so this likely wants to be a warning-level finding, or to only fire for paths under an existing directory. Check how lint classifies severity today before choosing.
description: Two items promoted on 2026-07-29 (motherduck-token-leak-via-chained-cause, platform-options-key-id-not-redacted) carried only_modify globs and verification-ladder commands naming test files that never existed - test_motherduck_adapter.py and test_platform_options.py, where the real files are test_motherduck.py and test_platform_options_capture.py. Consequences: check-scope reported a violation for the CORRECT file, and verify --run would have exited non-zero on a correct implementation, so the rung was left unrun. Scope and ladders are create-time-only, so neither could be repaired. Confirmed: 'todo lint <id>' returns 0 findings on the motherduck item today. lint DOES already flag 'has work units but no scope rules', so the machinery and the reporting path exist - this is a missing check, not new infrastructure.

preserves.behavior: An item whose scope legitimately names a not-yet-created file is not made un-createable
Existing lint findings (including the has-work-units-but-no-scope-rules check) keep firing unchanged

verifications.command: uv run -- python _project/scripts/todo_db.py lint motherduck-token-leak-via-chained-cause | grep -qi 'test_motherduck_adapter'
verifications.description: lint reports an unresolvable only_modify glob

work_units.summary: Resolve only_modify/do_not_modify globs during lint and report ones matching nothing
Resolve file-path arguments in verification commands the same way
Tests covering a resolvable glob, an unresolvable one, and a not-yet-created-file case
